_doc: Tracking and reminding (assistant/scripts/tracking/). Everything an organization tunes lives here; the code only interprets it. Lanes default to config.json -> lanes. Hours are local wall-clock. See assistant/TRACKING_DESIGN.md for the rulings behind each value.

chase._doc: Per-lane chaser over items that wait on an owner (open cards, staged tickets, fired follow-ups). One ask per lane per calendar day; the same item is re-asked only after reask_hours of silence; after max_follow_ups unanswered asks it folds (fold_daily_line true: no more cards, one quiet line a day listing the folded items until park_days pass or the owner answers; false: parked in silence for park_days). 'Remind me tomorrow' never counts toward max_follow_ups and resets a folded item's count.
chase._nudge_doc: line (default, the owner 2026-10-17 evening): ONE plain chat line a day per owner listing what waits on them, no buttons; a nudge is never a card, little decisions do not get cards, the item's own card is the thing to tap. card: the old one-card-per-lane nudge.
chase._exclude_doc: staged tickets never chased: a sentinel digest is itself a chase; personal texts stay out of the card stream (ruling 13)

drift._doc: Record-drift detectors: the record says one thing, the evidence says another. Each is on/off here. Findings ride the weekly card (hygiene) unless listed in 'urgent_kinds'.

crm_stage._fix_doc: 2026-10-18: a lagging stage is offered as a fix on the weekly card (hb_set_stage through the connector, read back). booked_stage = where a client still on a lead stage goes; post_event_stage = where a booked couple goes once the wedding is past. Stage NAMES as HoneyBook shows them.

drift._max_days_past_doc: a wedding that passed more than max_days_past days ago is history, not this week's hygiene

weekly._doc: The readback + hygiene card. readback_day is a weekday name; both go out once that day, after readback_after.

rhythm._doc: Measured, never set by hand: active hours from card answers + chat lines (last lookback_days); a chase kind with ignore_after unanswered asks and no answer in the window moves to the weekly card.

scheduling._doc: Ruling 12: Sage proposes 2-3 call slots in ONE card with the drafted message; the tap sends; when they pick one, a confirmation card and a calendar_hold card follow. Slots come from both owners' Google calendars (when connected) + the calendar file + HoneyBook meetings + our holds + times already offered. windows are local wall-clock per weekday; a weekday missing here is never offered.
scheduling.ask_words: \b(hop on a (?:quick )?call|set ?up a (?:quick )?(?:call|meeting|time|zoom)|schedule a (?:quick )?(?:call|meeting|zoom|time|chat)|(?:quick|phone|video|intro|discovery) call|chat on the phone|talk (?:on|over) the phone|are you free to (?:talk|chat|call)|time to (?:talk|chat|connect)|a call (?:this|next) week|consultation|facetime|zoom (?:call|meeting)|when are you (?:free|available)|what times? works? for you|jump on a call|get on a call|give (?:you|me) a call)\b

probation._doc: Ruling 9: a class of card may EARN automation after `threshold` as-is approvals in a row (an edit, a Skip, a typed note or an undo resets the run). At the threshold Sage posts ONE card asking; the code never flips a gate. How a flip is made by hand: README 'Probation'. A card belongs to a class when its exec kind is listed AND (for sends) its follow-up step or header matches.

record_write.title: internal record writes
record_write._what: the weekly record check, mined dates, calendar holds, HoneyBook notes and field updates: nothing a person outside the household sees

routine_client_send.title: routine client sends
routine_client_send._what: the post-wedding thank-you, the 'footage is safe' note, the 2-day quote follow-up

importance._doc: Lane weights (and the simple kind x age form advice.score keeps for items without a deadline). Items that carry a deadline / waiting_kind / hard are scored by the priority brain below (ruling 10).

priority._doc: The priority brain (scripts/tracking/priority.py, ruling 10): importance = lane weight x (1 + log10($ at stake) x dollar_weight + who waits + hard_bonus for a hard date); urgency from the deadline (1.0 at it, 3.0 deeply overdue); Eisenhower quadrant at important_at / urgent_at. Q2 (important, not urgent) items get q2_max_lines nudge lines in the Friday readback, never a card.

dayplan._doc: Tomorrow lined up the evening before (scripts/tracking/dayplan.py, ruling 6): at plan_at, once per day, when tomorrow has min_timed_items or more timed items (calendar events with a time, calls, deadlines, reminders that fire, chases due back) -> ONE plain message to the shared space in these blocks; owner's items in their own line only on days she has any; otherwise silence. All-day events are listed but count only with count_all_day.

chains._doc: Next-step chains live in assistant/chains.json (ruling 4); their ask cadence is set there under 'ask'.

routes._doc: Route clocks (minutes; the property planner's max_wait): an outcome that has waited longer than its route allows is unverified and the owner is asked once (outcomes.settle), instead of waiting again. Keys are route classes (outcomes.ROUTE_OF maps each kind).

graduation._doc: WP6 (2026-10-24, the property OS's followups/graduation.py): a card-gated action class is OFFERED for autonomy once min_samples resolved taps approved it unchanged (approve_min share, zero edits, zero undone, zero failed outcomes in window_days); the owner's tap grants it, one failed outcome demotes it. Sends, money, the doer's steps, prices and dates never graduate (graduation.FOREVER_GATED).
